title: New Aircrafts & Stunning Liveries in MSFS2020 Marketplace! ✈️✨ | Weekly Update | week 47
description:
🔍 Description
🚀This week, not too many new items have landed in the marketplace. Just two new aircraft: the Aeroprakt A-32 Vixxen and the RCZ Explorer Concept. One is a real-world aircraft and the other a concept, and you can clearly see the quality differences. In addition, for those who own Miltech's MH-60, there’s a new livery pack available with multiple fresh liveries for the helicopter.🌍🛫

📹 Other marketplace additions
If you are looking for either the new training missions or new enhanced scenery and enhanced airports review the respective video by clicking on one if the links below:
